This plot is very small, and I do not have money to buy a whole fertilizer bag just for this piece. I will do it the way I know from my own field and from other men near me: I will put manure on it, keep some local maize seed, and use family hands for weeding and planting. I do not irrigate here, and I will not spend cash on chemicals unless I have already seen them work and can afford them.
